description: This file defines Swagger API documentation classes for the Document Management API in the Apache Fineract project, including response schemas and a document upload request.

classes.name: DocumentManagementApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Contains nested static classes for API response schemas and a request class for document upload.

classes.name: PostEntityTypeEntityIdDocumentsResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response after posting a document entity.

classes.name: PutEntityTypeEntityIdDocumentsResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response after updating a document entity, including nested changes.

classes.name: PutEntityTypeEntityIdDocumentsResponseChangesSwagger
classes.description: Placeholder class for change details in the update response.

classes.name: DeleteEntityTypeEntityIdDocumentsResponse
classes.description: Schema for delete response of a document entity.

classes.name: DocumentUploadRequest
classes.description: Data class extending UploadRequest, for uploading documents with 'name' and 'description' fields.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the document.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the document.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the document.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the document.
